plan.title: LightGBM with charge features
plan.hypothesis: LightGBM with charge features provides a discriminating, reproducible comparison on the same grouped development folds.

features.name: fe_log_tenure
features.rationale: Compress tenure while retaining monotonic customer-age information.

features.name: fe_total_per_tenure
features.rationale: Approximate realized monthly spend; tenure zero becomes missing and is imputed inside each fold.

features.name: fe_monthly_x_tenure
features.rationale: Compare billed total with a simple expected cumulative charge.

features.name: fe_charge_gap
features.rationale: Expose billing deviation without using the churn target.

features.name: fe_log_total
features.rationale: Reduce the long-tailed scale of cumulative charges.

plan.expected_learning: Measure ranking, probability quality, robustness and the cost of this modeling choice.

blocks: paired development comparison; external confirmation pending
